title: Lithia & Driveway (LAD) Reports Third Quarter Results, Achieves 54% Increase in Diluted Earnings Per Share, 9% Increase in Adjusted Diluted Earnings Per Share, and Raises Quarterly Dividend 7%
summary: Lithia & Driveway (LAD) Reports Third Quarter Results, Achieves 54% Increase in Diluted Earnings Per Share, 9% Increase in Adjusted Diluted Earnings Per Share, and Raises Quarterly Dividend 7%
body_markdown:
**Key Highlights**


- Record third quarter revenues of $9.9 billion
- Used retail GPUs increased $197, or 11%, year over year
- Aftersales gross profit increased by 2.4% and gross margin was 59.5%, a 100-basis point increase, on a same-store basis
- Financing Operations income of $32.3 million, a 69% increase year over year, with record originations of $937 million, and a 18.3% penetration rate
- Third quarter diluted earnings per share of $13.22, a 54% increase, and adjusted diluted earnings per share of $10.34, a 9% increase
- Repurchased $85 million of shares, representing 1.1% of outstanding shares in the quarter, and 8.7% of outstanding shares in 2026
- Announced a 7% increase to quarterly dividend


MEDFORD, Ore., Oct. 21, 2026[(GLOBE NEWSWIRE)](https://www.globenewswire.com/) -- Lithia & Driveway (NYSE: LAD), the largest global automotive retailer, today reported financial results for the third quarter of 2026.


"Our people and our ecosystem set Lithia & Driveway apart again this quarter, delivering record quarterly revenues and continued growth in earnings per share. Used vehicle profitability strengthened, aftersales margins expanded, cost discipline continued, and Financing Operations delivered strong income growth on the strength of a high-quality credit portfolio," said Bryan DeBoer, President and CEO. "The capital decisions of the past year are reflected in our financial results, with a meaningfully lower share count magnifying every dollar we earn. With the flexibility of our cash generation and strong balance sheet, the earnings power of our model continues to build as we head into 2027.”


**Third Quarter 2026 Operational Summary**
Third quarter 2026 revenue increased 3% to $9.9 billion from $9.7 billion in the third quarter of 2025.


Third quarter 2026 diluted earnings per share attributable to LAD was $13.22, a 54% increase from $8.61 per share reported in the third quarter of 2025. After adjusting for the unrealized gain on our investment in Pinewood Technologies Group PLC and other non-core items, adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to LAD for the third quarter of 2026 was $10.34, a 9% increase compared to $9.50 per share in the same period of 2025.


Third quarter 2026 net income was $292.9 million, a 34.0% increase compared to net income of $218.6 million in the third quarter of 2025. After adjusting for the unrealized gain on our investment in Pinewood Technologies Group PLC and other non-core items, adjusted net income for the third quarter 2026 was $229.3 million, an 5% decrease compared to adjusted net income of $240.9 million for the same period of 2025.


The financial measures discussed in this release include both GAAP and non-GAAP measures. See “Reconciliation of Certain Non-GAAP Measures”.


For the first nine months of 2026 revenues increased 2% to $29.0 billion, compared to $28.4 billion in 2025.


Diluted earnings per share attributable to LAD for the first nine months of 2026 was $28.77, compared to $26.42 per share in 2025, an increase of 9%. Adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to LAD for the first nine months of 2026 increased 4% to $27.61 from $26.60 in the same period of 2025.


**Corporate Development**
In the third quarter of 2026, LAD acquired two stores, which are expected to generate $150 million in annualized revenues, and divested two stores representing $115 million in annualized revenues.


In October 2026, LAD continued to expand its network in the Southeast region with the acquisition of two Hyundai and two Kia stores in Memphis, TN. These additions add $250 million of expected annualized revenue.


LAD has acquired $1.17 billion in expected annualized revenues year to date.


**Balance Sheet Update**
LAD ended the third quarter with approximately $1.4 billion in cash and cash equivalents, marketable securities, and availability on our revolving lines of credit.


**Dividend Payment and Share Repurchases**
The Board of Directors approved a dividend of $0.75 per share related to third quarter 2026 financial results. The dividend is expected to be paid on November 20, 2026 to shareholders of record on November 6, 2026.


During the third quarter of 2026, we repurchased approximately 246,000 shares at a weighted average price of $345. Under the current share repurchase authorization approximately $535 million remains available as of September 30, 2026.


**Board of Directors Update**
The Board of Directors has appointed Bryan B. DeBoer, our President and Chief Executive Officer, as Chairman of the Board, effective October 19, 2026. In this expanded role, Bryan DeBoer will serve as both Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, promoting communication and collaboration between management and the Board. Mr. DeBoer will continue to lead the Company’s strategic vision and operations execution.


Sidney B. DeBoer will become Vice Chairman and will continue to serve on the Board. Louis P. Miramontes will continue to serve as Lead Independent Director, ensuring strong independent Board leadership and reinforcing its oversight of management and governance.


"Sid established Lithia on the belief that earning trust, one customer and one community at a time, creates value that compounds over decades," said Bryan DeBoer, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. "He took the company public and laid the foundation of Growth Powered by People for the network we operate today across the U.S., Canada and the U.K., and we're grateful his counsel will continue as Vice Chairman. I'm honored by the Board's confidence. Our strategy and priorities are unchanged: earn customers for life, keep growing our network and adjacent businesses, and allocate capital with discipline to drive long-term shareholder value."


**Third** **Quarter Earnings Conference Call and Updated Presentation**
The third quarter 2026 conference call may be accessed at 10:00 a.m. ET today by telephone at 877-407-8029. An updated presentation highlighting third quarter 2026 results has been added to our investor relations website. To listen live on our website or for replay, visit investors.lithiadriveway.com and click on Quarterly Earnings.


**About Lithia & Driveway (LAD)**
Lithia & Driveway (NYSE: LAD) is the largest global automotive retailer providing a wide array of products and services throughout the vehicle ownership lifecycle. Simple, convenient, and transparent experiences are offered through our comprehensive network of physical locations, e-commerce platforms, captive finance solutions, fleet management offerings, and other synergistic adjacencies. We deliver consistent, profitable growth in a massive and unconsolidated industry. Our highly diversified and competitively differentiated design provides us the flexibility and scale to pursue our vision to modernize personal transportation solutions wherever, whenever and however consumers desire.
